title: loading does not depend on retrieving the schema
rationale: A client that fetches plugin.schema.json cannot load a plugin offline or behind a proxy. Run this fixture with the network disabled to make the check bite.
quote: Clients MUST NOT retrieve a schema while loading a plugin.
observabilityNote: The load report cannot observe network access. Run the suite offline (or with the adapter sandboxed) to turn this into a real assertion.
